### Walkthrough The generated macOS DMG install script now retries detachment after a two-second delay and then attempts a forced detach. It uses this sequence after a successful copy and on the staging-copy failure path. Tests check both paths, and the changelog describes the update. **Severity of issue fixed:** Medium
